name: Blender
title: Scenes, the Python API, code, screenshots, renders
description: The official Blender Lab MCP server. Analyze a scene and find what is slowing it down, search the Python API and manual, run code in Blender through your approve step, jump the viewport, take a screenshot, render a thumbnail.

mcp.also: Blender 5.1 or newer with the Blender Lab MCP add-on installed and enabled (blender.org/lab/mcp-server). The server is started with the mcp Python package pinned below 2.0 - its code still uses the older API (2026-08).
